programs.title: Aloha, new home
programs.desc: Spouses Kamohai and Tristyn Kalama are native Hawaiians whose passion and mission is to renovate abandoned houses on the island of Oahu.Contrary to appearances, it is not just pleasant work in beautiful natural surroundings.Many of these properties are in a deplorable condition due to moisture, wind and sun.Renovations are additionally complicated by difficult terrain and changeable weather.However, the reward for designers is the end result, which is worth every moment spent renovating these amazing buildings.

programs.title: Naked and Afraid 6
programs.desc: Two unknown people, a woman and a man, are left in a lonely place with difficult climatic conditions.They must spend 21 days there without food, water or clothing.They can only take one item with them.Operators show how people relying on their own company learn to cooperate and make key decisions together.Viewers will see that appropriate knowledge and skills can be very useful in extreme moments and even determine survival.

programs.title: Woman at the end of the world
programs.desc: 90% of Koreans use the Internet, almost all of them do it every day.There they follow vloggers who play online games, or muk-bang, i.e. people eating in front of the camera.Online users also adopt virtual children or see the world from a cat's perspective.However, greater activity on the Internet is related to the real, deepening loneliness of Koreans.The heroine of the episode will be BJ Levi, who reports her life on the Internet - she is Muk-bang and she makes money from it.In Korean, the word "family" means people who eat together.It is generally accepted that no one should eat a meal alone.On the other hand, nowadays more and more people live away from their families, so BJe provide them with company.The best of them can earn up to $9-10,000 a month, which is two or three times more than corporate employees.The most popular ones gain the status of celebrities.
